components.name: Diagram/Org card
components.description: Person node for org charts and approval chains. Avatar (4.1, Size M), name, role, team. Collapsed shows the number of hidden reports as a Badge; tap expands the branch. Connect with Diagram/Connector (Elbow), parent above children. React: <OrgCard name role team avatar reports? collapsed? />
